3R replication script (analysis.R)

How to replicate: save the block below as analysis.R, place cleaned.csv (in the export bundle) beside it, then run Rscript analysis.R. The script prints every table shown in the app; the app's numbers were verified byte-for-byte against native R output. Package citations are in section 6.
# Reproducible analysis script generated by Telos
# Run from the folder holding cleaned.csv. Uncomment install.packages() the first time.
# install.packages(c("rdrobust"))
library(rdrobust)
d <- read.csv("cleaned.csv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

# === 01 · Regression discontinuity (RDD) ===
rd <- rdrobust::rdrobust(d$later_gpa, d$entrance_score, c = 60, p = 1, level = 95)
print(summary(rd))
# Bandwidth-sensitivity re-estimates at half/double the MSE-optimal h (R1 gap-fix)
h0 <- rd$bws[1, 1]
print(summary(rdrobust::rdrobust(d$later_gpa, d$entrance_score, c = 60, p = 1, level = 95, h = h0 / 2)))
print(summary(rdrobust::rdrobust(d$later_gpa, d$entrance_score, c = 60, p = 1, level = 95, h = h0 * 2)))
# Figure - RD plot (binned scatter + fitted lines either side of the cutoff)
print(rdrobust::rdplot(d$later_gpa, d$entrance_score, c = 60, hide = TRUE)$rdplot)

\documentclass{article}

\begin{document}

\midrule
Bandwidth & 12.97 \\

N (right) & 45 \\
\multicolumn{2}{l}{Bandwidth sensitivity - half h (6.49): estimate = 0.36, 95\% CI [0.18, 0.65]} \\

\includegraphics{figures/01_rdd/figure_rd-plot.png}

Estimates the jump in the outcome right at the cutoff - the estimate is the treatment effect for cases near the threshold. p/CI assess it; the RD plot shows the discontinuity visually. The jump is causal only if subjects cannot control which side of the cutoff they land on and nothing else changes at the same threshold - the footer reports the McCrary density test (a small p flags sorting/manipulation at the cutoff); also run covariate-balance / placebo checks. Method: R rdrobust package (Calonico, Cattaneo \& Titiunik, 2014, 2015).

At the cutoff, the treatment effect was 0.35, 95\% CI [0.21, 0.49], p $<$ .001.

Statistical basis: Robust bias-corrected local-polynomial regression discontinuity inference (Calonico, S., Cattaneo, M. D., Titiunik, R. (2014). "Robust Nonparametric Confidence Intervals for Regression-Discontinuity Designs." Econometrica, 82(6), 2295-2326.); Implementation (rdrobust package) (Calonico S, Cattaneo MD, Farrell MH, Titiunik R (2017). "rdrobust: Software for Regression-Discontinuity Designs." The Stata Journal, 17(2), 372-404.).

\end{document}

Harness README
# 38 · Regression discontinuity (RDD)

**Question:** effect at a cutoff

**Scenario:** Scholarship: does crossing the entrance-score cutoff raise later GPA (bandwidth-sensitivity check)?

## Input configuration

- **Dataset:** `scholarship.csv`
- **Configure-data:** app defaults (auto-detected types/levels)
- **Options:** cutoff 60 (explicit); bandwidth auto + half/double bandwidth-sensitivity re-estimates; polynomial order 1 (linear)

**Role assignments** (drag column → slot):

| Column | Role slot |
|---|---|
| `later_gpa` | outcome |
| `entrance_score` | running variable |
